notice: Verified recorded EnergyPlus result. This is a replay of a completed run, not a new calculation.
scope: The organiser fixed single atrium, one future Manchester hot week. No vertical temperature profile, individual-room comfort or structural assessment.

matchingContract.parameters: Exact normalized g, U, dayACH, nightACH and screenOpacity; no tolerance-based matching.
matchingContract.transforms: Exact normalized GUID and translationM set, sorted by GUID; both recorded examples have no geometry transforms.
matchingContract.revision: A browser revision is not proof of input identity. Editing must invalidate the displayed match immediately.
matchingContract.display: Keep a visible Recorded run badge and original completion time. Never label this replay fresh or current-run output. If inputs or setup do not match, show it only as a separate example, never as the current design result.

baseline.title: Original verified baseline

metricDerivations.scoreKh: Sum of max(operative temperature - 26 C, 0) over 70 occupied hours, rounded to one decimal as in the supplied GH definition.
metricDerivations.peakOperativeC: Maximum of the 168 calculated operative-temperature values before display rounding.
metricDerivations.ghReportedPeakOperativeC: One-decimal peak printed by the supplied GH component.

limitations: Single fixed reference atrium thermal zone; moving walls does not resize its thermal geometry, floor or volume.
Source geometry is reread and changed geometry can affect measured glazing and shading. Interior walls or faces below 19.35 m may have no thermal effect in this definition.
Future weather is the organiser crude temperature morph, not a validated future climate projection.
No thermal bridge, structural safety, airflow distribution or local comfort calculation.
Compare only fresh runs using identical EVAL IDs; supplied reference EC2F526D may use another engine stack.
